name: Mercadia
description: City on Mount Mercadia containing the tower.

description_citations.text: "Tower of the Magistrate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Mercadia the ship is upgraded and helps free the people from Phyrexian oppressors.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight was also instrumental in freeing the peoples of Mercadia from their Phyrexian oppressors.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight crashes on Mercadia, where Sisay gathers artifacts to repair the ship and leads the oppressed peoples to a change of regime.
timeline.quote: she led the oppressed peoples of the plane to a successful shift in regime

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn are arrested in Mercadia, Sisay, Hanna and Orim strike a deal with the Chief Magistrate to travel to Saprazzo for the Power Matrix.
timeline.quote: After the arrest of Gerrard , Tahngarth , and Karn in Mercadia

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cho-Manno declares Mercadia's masks can no longer hide the truth.
timeline.quote: Our day has come at last.

citation.text: Cho-Manno, Revolutionary (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight bursts from the underground hangar as Mercadia falls.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* burst from the underground hangar.

citation.text: Mercadia's Downfall (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takara betrays the group, steals the Bones of Ramos, and reveals she is Volrath.
timeline.quote: revealed her true identity: Volrath.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Magistrate is deposed by the people of Mercadia and the Weatherlight returns to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: The Magistrate was deposed by the rebelling people of Mercadia

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Kyren, once guardians of Thran council members, grow corrupt and become allies of Phyrexia and Rath.
timeline.quote: They are the descendants of a group of Goblins from Dominaria during the time of the Thran who were left in Mercadia

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ramos intercepts and destroys Volrath's ship Recreant as the Weatherlight flees the city.
timeline.quote: the dragon engine Ramos intercepted Volrath

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A revolution sweeps Mercadia City after the destruction of the Recreant.
timeline.quote: A revolution was then triggered that swept the city.

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Squee comes to be regarded as a cultural hero of the Kyren.
timeline.quote: the Dominarian goblin Squee would come to be regarded as a cultural hero of the Kyren

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia, the Cho-Arrim attack, and Hanna and others are arrested.
timeline.quote: The Weatherlight crash-landed on Mercadia after departing Rath.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew escapes Mercadia City with the Cho-Arrim prisoners and learns of the myths of Ramos.
timeline.quote: Here, they learned of the myths of Ramos and why the Cho-Arrim had taken the Weatherlight to begin with

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Power Matrix is stolen and the women are framed; Cho-Manno finds the real thief too late.
timeline.quote: the Power Matrix was stolen shortly after their arrival, and the women were framed for the crime.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath's plot is revealed; during the Revolution on Mercadia the crew escapes aboard the empowered Weatherlight with Ramos's help.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight managed to escape when Ramos himself came to their aid.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In myth Ramos saves people from the clash with his evil brother and brings them to Mercadia, where he falls from the sky in three pieces.
timeline.quote: Set ablaze by the planar jump, Ramos fell into three pieces: Mind, Soul, and Body.

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "The Myth of Ramos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In truth Ramos, a dragon engine crafted by Urza, gathers victims when the Golgothian Sylex is activated and is sent through a Phyrexian portal to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Ramos was merely a dragon engine crafted by Urza to battle Mishra and save those caught in the battlefield.

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "The Myth of Ramos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight escapes Rath and crash-lands in Mercadia, where the Cho-Arrim steal it.
timeline.quote: where the ship was stolen by the Cho-Arrim

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "The Mercadian Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew helps rebels overthrow the corrupt Mercadian government, ending in the Revolution.
timeline.quote: help the rebels overthrow the corrupt Mercadian government

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "The Mercadian Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed brings upper-class Thran from Halcyon to Mercadia to keep them safe from Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: brought to Mercadia by the planeswalker Dyfed in an act of compassion

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "Inhabitants". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in Mercadia and the crew becomes entangled in local power struggles.
timeline.quote: the Weatherlight crash-lands in Mercadia, a strange and unfamiliar plane

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cho-Arrim attack and steal the ship, and Mercadia City soldiers arrive to arrest the crew.
timeline.quote: The ship is attacked by the Cho-Arrim

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orim learns that Cho-Manno took the Weatherlight's arrival as a sign of Ramos's return, and grows sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim.
timeline.quote: Orim slowly becomes sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim's situation and is attracted to their leader.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mercadian magistrate offers Gerrard soldiers and Cateran mercenaries to recover the Weatherlight in exchange for the ship's return and safe passage.
timeline.quote: The Mercadian magistrate unexpectedly offers Gerrard an unusual deal.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the ensuing battle the Caterans slaughter the Cho-Arrim indiscriminately.
timeline.quote: the violent Caterans slaughter the Cho-Arrim indiscriminately

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara brokers a new deal: the crew will repair the Weatherlight for the magistrate in exchange for freedom; Sisay, Hanna and Orim head to Saprazzo for a needed artifact.
timeline.quote: Takara brokers a new deal with the magistrate

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara engineers the crew's escape; Gerrard's band finds Thran ruins, meets dryads and fights a mechanical war engine.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Takara engineers the crew's escape.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Atalla's family farm in Mercadia.
timeline.quote: A young man named Atalla watches as the Weatherlight crash lands on one of the fields of his family’s farm.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A sudden flood carries off the Weatherlight with warriors on boats during Mirri's memorial.
timeline.quote: A memorial service for Mirri and the other dead is interrupted by a sudden flood that brings in a band of warriors on boats and that starts to carry off the Weatherlight.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard negotiates a truce with the Mercadian riders and surrenders his weapons.
timeline.quote: Gerrard negotiates a truce and they agree to give up their weapons in exchange for the treatment of the wounded and proper burial of the dead.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Atalla steals the guard captain's keys, freeing Gerrard's crew.
timeline.quote: Atalla steals his keys and unlocks Gerrard’s shackles.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A cateran enforcer submits to Squee, allowing the crew to escape.
timeline.quote: At the sight of Squee, the cateran enforcer stops and seeks pardon from the goblin.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth confesses that he wishes he had died on Rath rather than live with the changes Volrath made.
timeline.quote: He wishes he had died there instead of having to live with the twisted changes effected upon him by Volrath.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orim rejects Gerrard's apology at his staged trial.
timeline.quote: Orim simply threw her turban at his feet.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Squee and Atalla drug the guards' wine to free the crew.
timeline.quote: The wine proves to be drugged, and Atalla secures the key to their shackles.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garbage falls on Xcric instead of the condemned Gerrard, Karn and Tahngarth.
timeline.quote: what they see is tons of filth fall right on top of Xcric!

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The magistrate lets the crew keep the Weatherlight in exchange for a mission to Saprazzo for the Matrix.
timeline.quote: The magistrate agrees to allow them to repair and keep the Weatherlight, in exchange for using it on a mission of the magistrate's choice.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Gerrard recounts rescuing his brother Vuel at his coming-of-age ceremony, which led to Vuel becoming Volrath.
timeline.quote: which started with Gerrard rescuing his brother Vuel from death during his coming-of-age ceremony

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn reveals that Starke corrupted Vuel and warns Gerrard not to trust Takara.
timeline.quote: Vuel only became Volrath when a vicious, conniving stranger came to their village and corrupted him

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath kills the chief artificer for failing to join the Power Matrix to the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: For her failure, Volrath kills her too, but at least now her assistant, the new chief, knows what they need.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Disguised as guards, the crew and Cho-Manno free Gerrard using a storm.
timeline.quote: The new guards are the rest of the Weatherlight crew, plus Cho-Manno.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The party is attacked by Deepwood ghouls on the way to Ouramos.
timeline.quote: they are attacked by Deepwood ghouls.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara, morphing into Volrath, takes Hanna and Karn captive and forces Hanna to repair the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: soon she morphs into her form as Volrath, who takes them captive.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight engine starts just as Volrath shoots at Squee.
timeline.quote: Just as Volrath shoots a crossbow bolt at Squee, the engine starts and the bolt just misses.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard defeats Volrath in a sword fight by attacking his weak side.
timeline.quote: Gerrard takes his chance and attacks the right, breaking through Volrath’s defenses, felling him.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Sisay are pulled aboard the Weatherlight, which Karn now controls through its engine.
timeline.quote: Now a rope comes down and Hanna and Tahngarth pull the two up on board.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight rams and destroys the Recreant; Volrath retreats to Rath.
timeline.quote: The stern rams into the Recreant, and destroys all but its prow

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ramos appears as a dragon engine and is hailed as the Uniter.
timeline.quote: Ramos and Orhop have fought and been united in the form of a dragon.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orim, Cho-Manno and Atalla become the new leaders of Mercadia as the crew planeshifts back to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: They return with Orim, Cho-Manno, and Atalla, new leaders of Mercadia.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia; the Cho-Arrim seize the ship and Orim, and Mercadians capture the rest of the crew.
timeline.quote: The Cho-Arrim , a reclusive forest-dwelling people, seized the ship along with Orim

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard negotiates with the Chief Magistrate to train the city's forces in exchange for help reclaiming the Weatherlight; Orim allies with Cho-Manno; the Caterans slaughter the Cho-Arrim.
timeline.quote: Gerrard agreed to train the city’s forces

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Mercadians and Caterans betray the crew, capturing the Weatherlight and imprisoning them.
timeline.quote: the Mercadians and Caterans betrayed them, capturing the Weatherlight and imprisoning the crew once more

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and allies realize Takara is Volrath in disguise, who executed Starke il-Vec.
timeline.quote: Takara , their companion from Rath, was none other than Volrath in disguise.

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Under Volrath's control, Hanna, Karn and Squee are forced to repair the Weatherlight; the revolutionary forces attack.
timeline.quote: forced to repair the Weatherlight under the threat of Squee’s execution

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew shoots down Volrath's flagship, but he escapes through a planar portal.
timeline.quote: the crew shot down Volrath’s vessel, though the shapeshifter himself managed to escape via a planar portal

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the Chief Magistrate dead and the Kyren rulers exiled, the peoples form a united government.
timeline.quote: With the Chief Magistrate dead and the Kyren rulers exiled

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The upgraded Weatherlight leaves Mercadia and Gerrard leads the crew back to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Gerrard, having embraced his role as a leader and savior, led his crew back to Dominaria

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia and the Cho-Arrim steal the ship.
timeline.quote: he could not prevent the rebels from stealing the ship

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth tells Hanna he feels himself a monster and sees his mutation as punishment for his vanity.
timeline.quote: he admitted that he felt himself a monster now

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew finds Orim alive among the Cho-Arrim and learns of the myths of Ramos.
timeline.quote: they found Orim alive and flourishing

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath, disguised as a crew member, is revealed to have orchestrated events; the crew escapes aboard the Weatherlight and destroys the Recreant, bringing peace to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Blasting the bigger ship apart, the crew of the Weatherlight ensured a new era of peace on Mercadia

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Mercadia Volrath turns the crew against each other, murders Starke, and tries to steal the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: He then took his revenge by murdering Starke and attempting to steal Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Revolution on Mercadia, Gerrard beats Volrath, who survives, pursues the Weatherlight, is defeated again and retreats to Rath.
timeline.quote: Volrath survived and pursued Weatherlight aboard Recreant

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A year later Freyalise erects a monument, and Karn, as an accumulation of the Legacy, takes Orim to Mercadia while Sisay, Squee and Tahngarth sail on the Victory.
timeline.quote: One year later, in a ceremony attended by survivors from all over the globe

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4308 Karona travels to Mercadia, meets the mechanical goblin Masters, and kills one who calls Gerrard a saboteur.
timeline.quote: Karona killed that Master and left.

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth has Dyfed exile the council to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth called upon Dyfed to exile the council to Mercadia

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mercadia becomes a target in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Mercadia was a target in the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "New Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A plague strikes the Cho-Arrim village; they blame Mercadia City, and war seems likely.
timeline.quote: The villagers blamed the denizens of Mercadia City for this

citation.text: "Cho-Arrim", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The cateran submits to Squee and lets the crew escape into Mercadia City.
timeline.quote: the cateran allowed the crew to escape into Mercadia City

citation.text: "Cliffside Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Yawgmoth seizes the empire, Dyfed takes the imprisoned elders to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Dyfed agreed to help Glacian, and took the elders, along with several goblin servants, to the plane of Mercadia

citation.text: "Dyfed", section "Creating the portal to Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed takes Thran nobles to Mercadia, who later build the city.
timeline.quote: Many years later, the Thran refugees built the powerful city of Mercadia

citation.text: "Mercadia City", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Revolution on Mercadia deposes and exiles the Kyren.
timeline.quote: the Kyren were deposed and exiled

citation.text: "Mercadia City", section "Revolution on Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karona kills one of the Masters in Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Karona killed one of the Masters and left

citation.text: "Mercadia City", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Orim and the Weatherlight crew are arrested and brought to Mercadia City.
timeline.quote: brought to Mercadia City

citation.text: "Rushwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath tortures Squee to force Hanna to fix the Weatherlight; allies intervene.
timeline.quote: Squee was tortured by Volrath to ensure compliance from Hanna

citation.text: "Squee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew overlooks Takara's cell; Volrath, shapeshifted as Takara, stows away and later kills Starke in Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Once in Mercadia, Volrath killed Starke

citation.text: "Takara en-Dal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
